prd.confirmed: Total quantity split into child orders inside a user-specified price range, with a child-order preview.
prd.unspecified: Actual App form, price distribution, quantity distribution, count/spacing and remainder rules. No Scaled-specific creation endpoint confirmed.

official_public_document.ordinary_order: POST /fapi/v3/order LIMIT requires quantity, price, timeInForce; newClientOrderId is a unique 1–36 character identifier. Signed GET /fapi/v3/order uses origClientOrderId to verify the exact child.
official_public_document.candidate_batch: POST /fapi/v3/batchOrders permits at most five child orders and concurrent independent results. This proves batch capability, not the official App Scaled implementation. This client does not use that endpoint.

initial_vanta_product_rule.confirmation: Previously proposed optional rule; no explicit product confirmation received. Rule displayed in form and confirmation. Do not describe as official Aster behavior.
initial_vanta_product_rule.count: User selects 2–5; initial client product limit.
initial_vanta_product_rule.prices: Inclusive valid endpoints; nearly equal ascending gaps. Interior price = low + floor(spanTicks * index / (count - 1)) * tick; all prices distinct.
initial_vanta_product_rule.quantity: Positive LOT_SIZE minimum plus whole steps. Subtract count * minimum, divide remaining whole steps equally, assign remainders from lowest price upward. Reject totals not exactly representable; never silently discard quantity.
initial_vanta_product_rule.notional: Exact Decimal sum of child price times quantity.
initial_vanta_product_rule.margin: Gross limit notional / leverage, explicitly before position netting; no fees, pending-order effects, released margin or executable allowance claimed.

execution: Independent ordinary LIMIT/GTC children sent sequentially in ascending price order. Fresh four-signature account/config/funds read before each child, then signed submit and independent signed original-ID query. Existing EOA signing path, no additional wallet.
failure_and_recovery: Freeze exact terms and independent IDs at confirmation.
Configuration/capability/expiry/account-event drift before a POST stops the remaining plan. Same-time account events also invalidate it.
Stop or route exit blocks unsent POSTs, while a sent order may still be queried. Already sent orders are not canceled.
A failed, rejected/canceled/expired or unresolved child stops later children; no automatic retry or compensation.
Each sent child uses existing durable pre-POST journal. Verified children are removed. Restart queries only unresolved sent IDs and never resumes the unsent plan.
boundaries: Partial success is possible; no atomicity or fill guarantee.
Real Aster self-EOA trading authorization remains unproven and enable-trading unfinished.
Initial rule does not include progressive/degressive quantities, geometric spacing, BBO or TP/SL children. PRD does not confirm these options.
No real private requests, financial actions, APK installation or device tools. Native/iOS checks remain pending.
